atomic_facts.fact: The full legal name of the individual known as Sam Bankman-Fried is Samuel Benjamin Bankman-Fried.
Sam Bankman-Fried was born on March 5, 1992.
On March 28, 2024, Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison.
He began serving that sentence immediately after sentencing, i.e., he was incarcerated following the March 28, 2024 sentencing.
As of July 1, 2026, Sam Bankman-Fried remains incarcerated.
He is serving a 25-year prison sentence.
No pardon or commutation has been granted to Sam Bankman-Fried.
